SamenvattingExperienced Reach Truck Driver wanted for a long-term logistics position in Amsterdam. Valid reach truck certificate and B1 English required. Salary starts from €16.00 gross per hour, with evening, night and Sunday allowances. Growth opportunities available.Over de functieWe are looking for an experienced Reach Truck Driver for a long-term logistics position in Amsterdam.
The ideal candidate has a valid reach truck certificate, previous warehouse experience and at least B1 level English. You will be responsible for operating a reach truck safely, placing pallets in high-rack storage, working in narrow aisles, transporting goods within the warehouse, supporting inbound and outbound operations, checking stock accuracy and preparing pallets for distribution.

Over het bedrijfOur client is a professional logistics company based in Amsterdam, specialized in warehouse distribution and supply chain operations. The company works with modern warehouse equipment and focuses strongly on safety, efficiency and teamwork. Employees have the opportunity to work in a structured logistics environment and develop further within warehouse and operator roles.

Wat wij vragenValid reach truck certificate
Previous experience as a reach truck driver
Minimum B1 level English
EU citizenship or a valid Dutch work permit is mandatory
Flexible with working hours
Safety-conscious, responsible and reliable
Able to work accurately in narrow aisles and high-rack storage
Physically able to perform warehouse duties
Long-term availability in the Netherlands
Forklift / heftruck certificate is an advantage

- 134% pay for hours worked between 18:00 and 06:00
200% pay on Sundays
- Possibility to earn up to €17.50 gross per hour after training and experience
- Long-term job opportunity in Amsterdam
- Possibility to grow into an operator role

Perhaps you are currently in a job where every day is the same. Time for something different – ​​variety, modern machinery, and a good salary with a shift allowance!

At Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you work as a production employee in a 5-shift system, which means you not only earn a good salary but also have extra free time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that plastic bottles and jerrycans are produced and packaged perfectly.

A job where you are actively engaged, work with technology, and every shift is different. Sounds good? Then be sure to read on 👇

Wat wordt er van je verwacht
As a production worker at Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you are an important link in the production process. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the machines keep running and that every product meets quality requirements.

You work in a 5-shift system, which keeps your work varied and gives you plenty of free time. During your shift, you are constantly busy: you maintain an overview, intervene where necessary, and ensure that everything runs neatly and efficiently.

Specifically, what you will be doing:
- You pack plastic bottles and jerrycans in a neat and careful manner
- You check the quality of products and identify deviations
- You measure products using tools such as a caliper
- You assist in keeping the production lines running
- You work together with colleagues to ensure production runs smoothly

In short: you ensure that everything is right — from production to packaging.

- You are 18 years or older

- You are flexible and have no problem working in a 5-shift system
- You work accurately and have an eye for quality
- You can collaborate well and maintain an overview in a busy environment
- You speak Dutch and/or English
